question: On the same burned single-capture REveL Development source, can a minimal causal common shape-change abstention/reset close the R0 producer defect and permit the frozen bbox-growth versus sparse-radial-flow parent-event comparison without manufacturing image scale?
difference_from_previous: R1 adds one pre-geometry native decoded-shape guard shared by both arms. A mismatched immediate pair emits FRAME_SHAPE_CHANGE abstention rows and uses the current frame as the next pair's only history. R0 remains immutable.

data_partitions.identity_basis: Exact R0 hash-bound 8,580-frame input freeze reused as burned Development data; no new Confirmation identity is claimed.
data_partitions.reuse_policy: R1 DEVELOPMENT ONLY; R0 FAILURE AND ALL PRIOR ACCESS DISCLOSED; NEVER SAME-CLAIM CONFIRMATION

independence_and_estimand.estimand: Fixed-denominator correct parent-event count and wrong-signed count for each frozen arm, plus the frozen flow-over-bbox advancement rule.

producer_allowlist: R0 frozen replay RGB image root
producer_forbidden: R0 candidate output, which does not exist
required_order: Freeze and independently pass R1 design.
Implement guard, atomic producer, evaluator bindings and fixtures.
Freeze and independently pass implementation identity.
Run representative no-truth pilot and guarded-host preflight.
Record a separately reviewed one-shot activation.
Run producer exactly once through guarded host.
Only after producer terminal, receipt and exact keyset pass may evaluator read truth and events.

shape_guard_contract.comparison: Exact native decoded grayscale ndarray shape tuple (H,W) of the current and immediate previous frame for the same target.
shape_guard_contract.position: After causal history/epoch and delta-t validation, before bbox area difference, ROI conversion, feature detection or LK.
shape_guard_contract.history_after_trigger: The current observation replaces the previous observation for that target. No feature, ROI, quality or earlier frame state crosses the mismatch. A following pair becomes evaluable only when its immediate previous and current decoded shapes match.
forbidden_repairs: drop the opportunity from an event denominator

inherited_without_change.source_input_and_truth_ledgers: R0 exact hashes and row identities
inherited_without_change.causality: current plus immediate previous only; lookahead zero
inherited_without_change.arm_parameters: R0 parameter identity except the common pre-arm FRAME_SHAPE_CHANGE behavior
inherited_without_change.output_fields: target_id, region, signed approach, quality, TTL, abstention and all R0 provenance fields
inherited_without_change.event_definition: R0 truth-only maximal same-target/same-truth-state parent event
inherited_without_change.event_evaluable: At least 3 finite rows and coverage >=0.50; all abstained rows remain in the denominator.
inherited_without_change.wrong_signed_definition: approaching predicted receding or receding predicted approaching; quasi-direction errors are incorrect but not wrong-signed
inherited_without_change.readiness_and_relative_gates: All R0 overall, truth-state, target, region, coverage-loss and wrong-sign gates unchanged

constraints.description: Frozen source preflight must reproduce all same-target same-epoch decoded-shape mismatches.
constraints.rationale: Binds the source defect denominator before candidate execution.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No alternate count; drift stops before producer.
constraints.revision_policy: New source identity or evidence version only.

constraints.description: Every one of 32 mismatch opportunities emits one row for each of two arms.
constraints.rationale: Prevents asymmetric support and hidden deletion.
constraints.calibration_source: 32 frozen opportunities times two frozen arms.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: None; any other count invalidates producer.

constraints.description: Producer preserves one row per arm for every replay opportunity.
constraints.rationale: Maintains the full fixed replay denominator.
constraints.calibration_source: 13,014 frozen replay opportunities times two arms.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: No row dropping or common-success subset.

constraints.description: Evaluator keeps every frozen primary parent event for both arms.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Three/eight-frame counts remain diagnostic only as in R0.

constraints.description: Formal producer requires a representative real-mechanics pilot, independently validated guarded-host preflight, exclusive atomic outputs and a separately reviewed one-shot activation.
Producer cannot import, read, overwrite or derive truth/event/Vicon/old-decision content; evaluator touches truth only after producer identity and exact keyset validation.
R1 cannot resize, pad, crop or letterbox decoded frames because apparent scale is the estimand signal.

locked: R0 input/truth/event identities and scientific gates
native shape comparison and reason precedence
guarded one-shot execution and no old F-1B decision access

successor_policy.design_review_pass_effect: Authorize implementation, fixtures, stable root adapter, pilot and implementation identity only; formal producer still requires separate guarded-host preflight and activation review.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: R0 failed at the first of 32 exact native shape mismatches; resize or pad would alter scale-sensitive bbox and radial-flow signals.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Only pairs with unequal immediate decoded shapes change behavior, and both arms receive the identical abstention/reset.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether the original scientific comparison is executable after removing the known interface discontinuity without manufacturing apparent scale.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Synthetic enter/stay/exit shape segment fixture, exact source preflight, representative no-truth pilot and one full guarded producer.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Exact 64 common shape abstention rows, 26,028 total rows, complete producer receipt, then unchanged 469-event evaluation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any shape mismatch reaches bbox/LK, counts drift, rows drop, atomic/progress contract fails, or fixed-event evaluation remains unavailable.
hypotheses.resource_budget: One source audit, one implementation, bounded synthetic fixtures, two equivalent 2,000-row pilots, one full producer and one conditional evaluator.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Stop R1 on design/identity/preflight failure or the first formal producer/evaluator failure; do not tune or rerun.
hypotheses.selection_reason: A common abstention is the narrowest repair that protects the scale estimand and addresses every observed crash boundary.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Prove the shared guard on analytic shape transitions, reproduce 32 source mismatches, then run exactly one fixed full replay.
experiment_design.resource_budget: 13,014 replay rows, 8,363 decoded images, two frozen arms, one 2,000-row scheduling/equivalence pilot per compared thread setting, one guarded full producer and one post-keyset evaluator.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop before truth on any identity, shape count, output completeness, progress, atomic publication or firewall failure; after valid join accept the unchanged R0 scientific terminal.

predecessor_failure_learning.observation: R0 crashed before publication at a same-target same-epoch pair whose decoded shapes were 260x346 and 258x346.
predecessor_failure_learning.inference: The evidence version lacked a pre-geometry decoded-shape contract; no arm effectiveness inference is supported.
alternative_explanations: Some same-size frames may still contain unobserved crop or rescale changes.
A later unrelated OpenCV or source defect may appear after the first guard is fixed.
constraint_challenges: A blanket no-repair terminal was appropriate for R0 identity but must not close the research question.
Global normalization is rejected because it would change the scale signal.
next_hypotheses: The common shape guard is sufficient for complete producer execution.
The 64 abstention rows do not make fixed parent-event evaluation unavailable.
reuse_candidates: R0 failure receipt as regression fixture.
The 32 mismatch pairs as source-boundary canaries.
predecessor_failure_learning.information_gain: The failure was localized to 0.2485 percent of eligible pairs in 11 short source segments, making a narrow common guard higher-value than global image normalization.
